parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the wheel of the cart, made of wood, typically circular and attached to the front axle. It is a key component for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during movement. It reduces friction and enables directional control.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to facilitate forward and backward motion of the cart.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the cart, made of wood, forming the container and handles. It supports the load and provides grip points for the user.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the materials being transported and provides handles for pushing or pulling the cart.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheel, serving as the structural frame that moves as the wheel rotates.
